steps.en: OCMS creates a work item for endorsement after the decision is applied
steps.id: OCMS membuat work item untuk endorsement setelah keputusan diterapkan
steps.why_en: No work item is created; the creation code is only a placeholder.
steps.why_id: Work item tidak dibuat; code pembuatannya hanya placeholder.

steps.en: The work item is routed to the officer's supervisor dashboard
steps.id: Work item diarahkan ke dashboard supervisor officer
steps.why_en: There is no supervisor dashboard or routing to a supervisor.
steps.why_id: Tidak ada dashboard supervisor maupun routing ke supervisor.

steps.en: Supervisor can endorse the decision made on the notices
steps.id: Supervisor dapat meng-endorse keputusan pada notice
steps.why_en: An endorse screen exists only for UPL notices, one at a time, without a working backend.
steps.why_id: Layar endorse hanya ada untuk notice UPL, satu per satu, tanpa backend yang jalan.

steps.en: The decision only takes effect after the supervisor endorses it
steps.id: Keputusan baru berlaku setelah supervisor meng-endorse
steps.why_en: Decisions take effect immediately; nothing waits for a supervisor.
steps.why_id: Keputusan langsung berlaku; tidak ada yang menunggu supervisor.
